name: When should I consider professional wall repair instead of a DIY fix?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional wall repair instead of a DIY fix?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider professional wall repair for significant damage, such as large holes, extensive water damage, or cracks that indicate structural issues. While minor cosmetic imperfections might be suitable for DIY, attempting complex repairs without proper knowledge and tools can lead to unsatisfactory results or even exacerbate the problem. A professional assessment helps ensure the repair is done correctly and addresses any underlying concerns, offering a more durable and aesthetically pleasing outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose professional repair for significant damage like large holes or structural cracks, as DIY attempts can worsen complex issues.
